H6800.def: a primitive root; to humiliate:--humbly, lowly.

H6801.def: a primitive root; to wrap, i.e. roll or dress:--be attired, × surely, violently turn.

H6803.def: from the same as «06791»; a vase (probably a vial tapering at the top):--pot.

H6804.def: probably from the same as «06794»; a tube:--pipe.

H6805.def: a primitive root; to pace, i.e. step regularly; (upward) to mount; (along) to march; (down and causatively) to hurl:-- bring, go, march (through), run over.

H6806.def: from «06804»; a pace or regular step:--pace, step.

H6807.def: feminine of «06806»; a march; (concretely) an (ornamental) ankle-chain:--going, ornament of the legs.

H6808.def: a primitive root; to tip over (for the purpose of spilling or pouring out), i.e. (figuratively) depopulate; by implication, to imprison or conquer; (reflexive) to lie down (for coitus):--captive exile, travelling, (cause to) wander(-er).

H6809.et: from an unused root meaning to wrap over
H6809.def: from an unused root meaning to wrap over; a veil:--vail.

H6810.def: or tsanowr {tsaw-ore'}; from «06819»; little; (in number) few; (in age) young, (in value) ignoble:--least, little (one), small (one), + young(-er, -est).

H6811.def: the same as «06810»; Tsair, a place in Idumaea:--Zair.

H6812.def: feminine of «06810»; smallness (of age), i.e. juvenility:--youth.

H6813.def: a primitive root; to load up (beasts), i.e. to migrate:--be taken down.

H6814.def: of Egyptian derivation; Tsoan, a place in Egypt:--Zoan.

H6815.def: or (dual) Tsaeanayim {tsah-an-ah'-yim}; plural from «06813»; removals; Tsaanannim or Tsaanajim, a place in Palestine:--Zaannannim, Zaanaim.

H6816.et: from an unused root meaning to bestrew with carvings
H6816.def: from an unused root meaning to bestrew with carvings; sculpture:--image (work).

H6817.def: a primitive root; to shriek; (by implication) to proclaim (an assembly):--X at all, call together, cry (out), gather (selves) (together).

H6819.def: a primitive root; to be small, i.e. (figuratively) ignoble:--be brought low, little one, be small.

H6820.def: from «06819»; little; Tsoar, a place East of the Jordan:--Zoar.

H6822.def: a primitive root; properly, to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance; by implication, to observe, await:-- behold, espy, look up (well), wait for, (keep the) watch(-man).

H6823.et: a primitive root [probably identical with (06822) through the idea of expansion in outlook, transferring to action]
H6823.def: a primitive root (probably identical with «06822» through the idea of expansion in outlook, transferring to action); to sheet over (especially with metal):--cover, overlay.

H6825.def: or Tsphiy {tsef-ee'}; from «06822»; observant; Tsepho or Tsephi, an Idumaean:--Zephi, Zepho.

H6828.def: or tsaphon {tsaw-fone'}; from «06845»; properly, hidden, i.e. dark; used only of the north as a quarter (gloomy and unknown):--north(-ern, side, -ward, wind).

H6829.def: the same as «06828»; boreal; Tsaphon, a place in Palestine:--Zaphon.

H6831.def: patronymically from «06827»; a Tsephonite, or (collectively) descendants of Tsephon:--Zephonites.

H6832.def: from the same as «06848»; excrement (as protruded):--dung.

H6833.def: or tsippor {tsip-pore'}; from «06852»; a little bird (as hopping):--bird, fowl, sparrow.

H6834.def: the same as «06833»; Tsippor, a Moabite:--Zippor.

H6835.et: from an unused root meaning to expand
H6835.def: from an unused root meaning to expand; a saucer (as flat):--cruse.

H6837.def: from «06822»; watch-tower; Tsiphjon, an Israelite:--Ziphion. Compare «06827».

H6838.def: from the same as «06835»; a flat thin cake:--wafer.

H6839.def: plural of active participle of «06822»; watchers; Tsophim, a place East of the Jordan:--Zophim.

H6842.def: from «06852»; a male goat (as prancing):--(he) goat.

H6843.def: feminine formed like «06842»; a crown (as encircling the head); also a turn of affairs (i.e. mishap):--diadem, morning.

H6845.def: a primitive root; to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk:--esteem, hide(-den one, self), lay up, lurk (be set) privily, (keep) secret(-ly, place).

H6846.def: or Tsphanyahuw {tsef-an-yaw'-hoo}; from «06845» and «03050»; Jah has secreted; Tsephanjah, the name of four Israelites:--Zephaniah.

H6847.def: of Egyptian derivation; Tsophnath-Paneach, Joseph's Egyptian name:--Zaphnath-paaneah.

H6848.et: from an unused root meaning to extrude
H6848.def: from an unused root meaning to extrude; a viper (as thrusting out the tongue, i.e. hissing):--adder, cockatrice.

H6849.def: feminine from the same as «06848»; an outcast thing:--issue.

H6850.def: a primitive root; to coo or chirp (as a bird):--chatter, peep, whisper.

H6851.def: from «06687»; a willow (as growing in overflowed places):--willow tree.

H6852.def: a primitive root; to skip about, i.e. return:--depart early.

H6854.et: from (06852) and a word elsewhere unused meaning a swamp
H6854.def: from «06852» and a word elsewhere unused meaning a swamp; a marsh-leaper, i.e. frog:--frog.

H6855.def: feminine of «06833»; bird; Tsipporah, Moses' wife:--Zipporah.

H6856.et: from (06852) (in the denominative sense [from (06833)] of scratching)
H6856.def: from «06852» (in the denominative sense (from «06833») of scratching); properly, a claw, i.e. (human) nail; also the point of a style (or pen, tipped with adamant):--nail, point.

H6857.def: from «06822»; watch-tower; Tsephath, a place in Palestine:--Zephath.

H6858.et: from an unused root meaning to encircle
H6858.def: from an unused root meaning to encircle; a capital of a column:--chapiter.

H6859.def: the same as «06857»; Tsephathah, a place in Palestine:--Zephathah.

H6860.def: or Tsiyqlag (1 Chronicles 12:1,20) {tsee-kel-ag'}; of uncertain derivation: Tsiklag or Tsikelag, a place in Palestine:--Ziklag.

H6861.et: from an unused root meaning to wind
H6861.def: from an unused root meaning to wind; a sack (as tied at the mouth):--husk.

H6862.def: or tsar {tsawr}; from «06887»; narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble (as in «06864»); (transitive) an opponent (as crowding):--adversary, afflicted(-tion), anguish, close, distress, enemy, flint, foe, narrow, small, sorrow, strait, tribulation, trouble.

H6863.def: from «06887»; rock; Tser, a place in Palestine:--Zer.

H6864.def: from «06696»; a stone (as if pressed hard or to a point); (by implication, of use) a knife:--flint, sharp stone.

H6865.def: or Tsowr {tsore}; the same as «06864»; a rock; Tsor, a place in Palestine:--Tyre, Tyrus.

H6867.def: from «06686»; conflagration (of fire or disease):--burning, inflammation.

H6868.et: apparently from an unused root meaning to pierce
H6868.def: or Tsredathah {tser-ay-daw'-thaw}; apparently from an unused root meaning to pierce; puncture; Tseredah, a place in Palestine:--Zereda, Zeredathah.

H6869.def: feminine of «06862»; tightness (i.e. figuratively, trouble); transitively, a female rival:--adversary, adversity, affliction, anguish, distress, tribulation, trouble.

H6870.et: pass part from the same as (06875)
H6870.def: feminine passive participle from the same as «06875»; wounded; Tserujah, an Israelitess:--Zeruiah.

H6871.def: feminine passive participle of «06879»; leprous; Tseruah, an Israelitess:--Zeruah.

H6872.def: or (shorter) tsror {tser-ore'}; from «06887»; a parcel (as packed up); also a kernel or particle (as if a package):--bag, × bendeth, bundle, least grain, small stone.

H6873.def: a primitive root; to be clear (in tone, i.e. shrill), i.e. to whoop:--cry, roar.

H6874.def: the same as «06875»; Tseri, an Israelite:--Zeri. Compare «03340».

H6875.et: from an unused root meaning to crack [as by pressure], hence, to leak
H6875.def: or tsoriy {tsor-ee'}; from an unused root meaning to crack (as by pressure), hence, to leak; distillation, i.e. balsam:--balm.

H6876.def: patrial from «06865»; a Tsorite or inhabitant of Tsor (i.e. Syrian):--(man) of Tyre.

H6877.et: from (06873) in the sense of clearness of vision
H6877.def: from «06873» in the sense of clearness of vision; a citadel:--high place, hold.

H6878.et: from an unused root meaning to need
H6878.def: from an unused root meaning to need; need:--need.

H6879.def: a primitive root; to scourge, i.e. (intransitive and figurative) to be stricken with leprosy:--leper, leprous.

H6881.def: apparently another form for «06880»; Tsorah, a place in Palestine:--Zareah, Zorah, Zoreah.

H6882.def: or Tsortathiy {tsor-aw-thee'}; patrial from «06881»; a Tsorite or Tsorathite, i.e. inhabitants of Tsorah:--Zorites, Zareathites, Zorathites.

H6884.def: a primitive root; to fuse (metal), i.e. refine (literally or figuratively):--cast, (re-)fine(-er), founder, goldsmith, melt, pure, purge away, try.

H6885.def: from «06884»; refiner; Tsorephi (with the article), an Israelite:--goldsmith's.

H6886.def: from «06884»; refinement; Tsarephath, a place in Palestine:--Zarephath.

H6887.def: a primitive root; to cramp, literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive (as follows):--adversary, (be in) afflict(-ion), beseige, bind (up), (be in, bring) distress, enemy, narrower, oppress, pangs, shut up, be in a strait (trouble), vex.

H6888.def: apparently by erroneous transcription for «06868»; Tsererah for Tseredah:--Zererath.

H6889.def: perhaps from «06671»; splendor; Tsereth, an Israelite:--Zereth.

H6890.et: from the same as (06889) and (07837) with the article interposed
H6890.def: from the same as «06889» and «07837» with the article interposed; splendor of the dawn; Tsereth-hash-Shachar, a place in Palestine:--Zareth-shahar.

H6891.def: perhaps for «06868»; Tsarethan, a place in Palestine:--Zarthan.

H6894.def: from «06895»; a hollow, i.e. vessel used as a (dry) measure:--cab.

H6895.def: a primitive root; to scoop out, i.e. (figuratively) to malign or execrate (i.e. stab with words):--X at all, curse.

H6896.def: from «06895»; the paunch (as a cavity) or first stomach of ruminants:--maw.

H6898.def: from «06895»; a pavilion (as a domed cavity):--tent.
